;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**The [[Israeli Defence Forces]] releases footage of a man fatally shot yesterday during an apparent attempt to breach the [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]n border fence. [[Israel]] says he was carrying an [[AK-47]] and explosive devices including [[grenade]]s, and accused [[Hamas]] of "playing with fire". [https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5221186,00.html (Ynet News)]
*[[Ukrainian crisis]], [[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|War in Donbass]]
**[[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Petro Poroshenko]] holds a press conference in [[Vinnytsia]] announcing the end of the [[ATO zone|anti-terror operation]] in [[Donbass]] in May. It will be replaced with a military force. [https://www.unian.info/politics/10070066-anti-terrorist-operation-in-donbas-to-end-in-may-poroshenko.html (UNIAN)]
*[[Terrorism in Turkey]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] [[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] calls 15 peaceful anti-war protestors arrested last month at [[Boğaziçi University]] in [[Istanbul]] terrorists and says they will not be allowed to complete their education. [https://www.timeshighereducation.com/news/terrorist-students-must-be-expelled-says-turkeys-president (''Times Higher Education'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[List of earthquakes in California|Earthquakes in California]]
**A magnitude 5.3 earthquake, the strongest in the region in four years, takes place near [[Santa Cruz Island]] off the coast of [[California]], being felt as far as [[Riverside, California|Riverside]]. No injuries are reported. [http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-earthquake-channel-islands-20180405-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*A bus crash in Makomero, [[Tanzania]], kills 12 people and injures 46. [https://www.news24.com/Africa/News/12-dead-and-46-injured-in-tanzania-bus-crash-20180405 (News24)]
*An [[F-15K]] [[fighter jet]] crashes on a mountainside in [[Chilgok]], [[South Korea]]. One pilot is killed and another is missing, presumed dead. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/south-korean-military-says-fighter-jet-crashes-on-mountain/2018/04/05/4f460014-389d-11e8-af3c-2123715f78df_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*A fire breaks out on the roof of a hospital in [[Gaziosmanpasa]], [[Istanbul]], and spreads down the outside to ground level. [[Ministry of Health (Turkey)|Minister of Health]] Ahmet Demircan say all patients have been evacuated and transferred to hospitals elsewhere by ambulances. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/05/europe/istanbul-hospital-fire-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[2017–18 Philippine dengue vaccination controversy]]
**The [[Department of Justice (Philippines)|Public Attorney's Office]] filed the criminal charges against former [[Department of Health (Philippines)|Health]] Secretary [[Janette Garin]] and other executives from [[Sanofi Pasteur]] and Zuellig Pharma Corporation, the manufacturer and distributor of dengue vaccine called Dengvaxia. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/199657-dengvaxia-victims-families-criminal-complaint-doh-sanofi-zuellig (Rappler)]
*Medically [[assisted suicide]] became legal in the state of [[Hawaii]]. [https://www.apnews.com/91a066e44af64b538eaa7472bf6a9cb2/Medically-assisted-suicide-becomes-legal-in-Hawaii (AP)]

;International relations
*[[China–North Korea relations]]
**[[Workers' Party of Korea|Korean Workers' Party]] [[Chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea|chairman]] [[Kim Jong-un]] has reportedly told [[Communist Party of China|Chinese Communist Party]] [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China|general secretary]] [[Xi Jinping]] that he is willing to resume [[six-party talks]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/north-koreas-kim-told-xi-wanted-resume-six-114119544.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]]
**[[Vasily Nebenzia]], the [[Russia]]n ambassador to the [[United Nations]], tells the [[UN Security Council]] the [[United Kingdom]] has created a "fake story" and says Russia has "told our British colleagues that you are playing with fire and you will be sorry." [[Permanent Representative of the United Kingdom to the United Nations|UK representative to UN]] [[Karen Pierce]] tells the Security Council UK actions "stand up to any scrutiny" and compares Russian requests to join the investigation to an arsonist investigating their own fire. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43662421 (BBC)]
*[[First Trump tariffs|Trump tariffs]], [[China–United States relations]]
**Trump instructs officials to consider a further $100 billion of tariffs against China in addition to the $50 billion worth of US tariffs already proposed on hundreds of Chinese imports. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-43664243 (BBC)] 

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Turkey]]
**At [[Eskişehir Osmangazi University]], central [[Turkey]], a research assistant shoots and kills four staff members. Media report that three people are wounded and that the shooter has turned himself in to police. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/04/05/four-staff-members-killed-after-research-assistant-opens-fire-at-turkish-university.html (Fox News)]
*[[Operation Car Wash]]
**[[Brazil]]ian federal judge [[Sérgio Moro]] orders the arrest of former [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] by late Friday to begin serving a 12-year sentence for corruption. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-lula-prison/brazil-judge-orders-ex-president-lula-jailed-by-friday-afternoon-idUSKCN1HC2TJ (Reuters)]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**Newly released documentation reveals Benjamin Morrow, a man killed by an explosion on March 5 in his home in [[Beaver Dam, Wisconsin|Beaver Dam]], [[Wisconsin]], possessed [[white supremacy|white supremacist]] literature, five guns with ammunition, boxes of [[binary explosives]], jars of explosive [[TATP]], and a small explosives manufacturing laboratory. [http://www.wiscnews.com/bdc/news/local/man-killed-in-beaver-dam-explosion-had-explosives-lab-in/article_3e0e1350-067a-51fc-87b6-7ad8a4941177.html (Wisc News)]
*[[Orlando nightclub shooting]]
**Sixteen survivors use anti-terror legislation to sue [[Google]], [[Twitter]] and [[Facebook]], alleging the firms "provided support and resources" to [[ISIL|the Islamic State]]. [https://www.wsbtv.com/news/trending-now/pulse-survivors-sue-twitter-google-facebook-claim-companies-support-isis/727563534 (WSB-TV)]
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**Former major of the [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] [[Josep Lluís Trapero Álvarez|Josep Lluís Trapero]] is charged with two counts of sedition and one of criminal organisation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43653798 (BBC)]
**Former director of the [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] Pere Soler, former Lt. [[Teresa Laplana]], and former General Secretary of Catalan Ministry of the Interior [[Cèsar Puig]] are charged with one count of sedition and one of criminal organitsation. [http://www.rtve.es/noticias/20180405/juez-audiencia-nacional-procesa-trapero-sedicion-organizacion-criminal/1709280.shtml (RTVE)]
*[[Twitter suspensions]]
**[[Twitter]] announces the suspension of 1.2 million terror-linked accounts since 2015. [http://fortune.com/2018/04/05/twitter-terrorist-account-suspensions/ (''Fortune'')]
*Around 20 armed robbers attack a police station with guns and a bank with dynamite in [[Offa]], [[Kwara State]], [[Nigeria]]. The shooting kills nine and the explosion kills seven. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/06/africa/nigeria-bank-robbery/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Human rights in Vietnam]]
**A [[Vietnam]]ese court sentences six high-profile Brotherhood for Democracy activists to prison on charges of attempting to overthrow the government, with the longest sentence handed to [[human rights]] lawyer [[Nguyễn Văn Đài]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-43659830 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2018 in UFC]]
**An arrest warrant is issued for [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] (UFC) lightweight champion [[Conor McGregor]] after he was involved in a melee at a press conference at the [[Barclays Center]] in [[New York City]] ahead of [[UFC 223]]. Video footage appears to show McGregor throwing a [[hand truck]] through a window of the [[Khabib Nurmagomedov]] team bus. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2018/apr/05/conor-mcgregor-ufc-media-day-ruckus (''The Guardian'')]
